title: Contracted katakana: B and P rows — write in kana
description: Use a Latin-letter spelling cue and base sign to distinguish small ャ/ュ/ョ from full-sized kana.

reviewItems.skill: Write katakana ビャ (contracted bya spelling)
Write katakana ビュ (contracted byu spelling)
Write katakana ビョ (contracted byo spelling)
Write katakana ピャ (contracted pya spelling)
Write katakana ピュ (contracted pyu spelling)
Write katakana ピョ (contracted pyo spelling)

exercises.prompt: Type the contracted katakana bya using the ビ base sign and a small kana. Do not use a full-sized kana.
exercises.explanation: ビャ is the contracted bya spelling. Small ャ joins ビ; ビヤ uses full-sized ヤ. These written forms are not interchangeable.
